name: perfuselab
description: PerfuseLab dashboard com API MongoDB para casos de perfusao/CEC.

scripts.check: npm run check:server && npm run check:dashboard && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check:server: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/config/database.js && node --check server/config/cors.js && node --check server/routes/cases.js && node --check server/models/PerfusionCase.js && node --check server/middleware/errorHandler.js
scripts.check:dashboard: node --check src/js/cases.js && node --check src/js/checklist-template.js && node tools/validate-dashboard.js
